scope: Behavior, ARIA and form participation of the web component in happy-dom (node:test). Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: keys, Page Up 10%, Home/End, pointer mapping, ratio variable, determinate and indeterminate progress
the data-* state contract (contracts/states.json): the same state attributes on the web component (happy-dom) and the React renderer (SSR) for the same state; field state after blur, typing and focus

Base UI event details on both renderers: change / input / openchange detail { value | checked | pressed | open, reason, event } and React (value, { reason, event }) with the same reasons; value / defaultValue, checked / defaultChecked; select open / defaultOpen

composition: authored [data-part] parts render the same parts, recipe classes, data-* and hidden flags as the generated anatomy; authored attributes, classes and content are adopted, text seeds properties, a reconnect keeps them
range pair: group host and two slider thumbs, keys stop at the other thumb, pointer moves the nearer thumb, one form entry per thumb, reset, activeThumbIndex; the same data-* as React
native input/progress inside a data-ui host, construction-pattern parts, form names and values, no custom elements
the data-* state contract (contracts/states.json): the same state attributes on the web component (happy-dom) and the React renderer (SSR) for the same state; field state after blur, typing and focus

Base UI event details on both renderers: change / input / openchange detail { value | checked | pressed | open, reason, event } and React (value, { reason, event }) with the same reasons; value / defaultValue, checked / defaultChecked; select open / defaultOpen
composition: each compound-part form renders the server markup of its preset; render (element or function) and className functions of the part state
range pair: a group of two thumbs with native inputs (data-index, names), the preset equals the composed parts, keys stop at the other thumb, onValueChange activeThumbIndex

limitations: Geometry review of the range pair (manual, 2026-11-02): the track family (resolveTrack, trackPairFill) checked for two thumbs in apps/studio/geometry-check.html at every size x B 0 and 1 (host height, thumb size, each thumb offset, fill start and width, both concentric caps; a negative control with the expected fill start off by 1px failed 46 cases); growth: the pair keeps the 24u minimum width and grows with its container, thumbs never shrink, met thumbs show a 4u fill pill around them; RTL: thumbs and the fill mirror (margin-inline-start) and the arrows flip; focus: the keyboard ring is the thumb outline (no size change), the focused or dragged thumb paints over the other; react-check.html compares the React pair with ui-range (twins and composed parts, "fails": []); light and dark screenshots of the Tracks family.
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares each React twin with its web component at five sizes ("fails": []).
